intro.title: Redux Toolkit — createSlice & createAsyncThunk
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple React app that fetches and displays a list of users from a mock API using Redux Toolkit. You will learn how to use createSlice to define a Redux state slice with reducers for managing user data, and createAsyncThunk to handle asynchronous API calls. The main technologies involved are React, Redux Toolkit, and JavaScript's async/await pattern. By the end, you'll understand how to structure async logic and state updates in a modern Redux application.
intro.usecase: In real-world applications, managing complex state like user data, API responses, and UI loading states is common in features such as e-commerce dashboards or social media feeds. For instance, when a user views their order history, createSlice handles local state like filters, while createAsyncThunk fetches order data from a server, showing loaders during the request. This pattern ensures predictable state updates and efficient handling of asynchronous operations, making it essential for scalable React apps with dynamic content.
